subject: Scheduling dedicated capacity sizing call - Redwood for FintechCo

From: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>

Subject: Re: Discovery — Redwood for FintechCo (next steps)

Hi Jamie — great conversation earlier today, thanks for the time. Quick recap and suggested next steps so we can get into a sizing/technical deep dive: 

Recap from discovery:
- Primary workload: user-facing chat assistant (customer support + transaction summaries) and background embeddings for semantic search.
- Estimated steady-state: ~5k requests/day currently, expected to ramp to ~150k requests/day in 3 months as feature launches.
- Peak patterns: spikes during business hours and promo events (expected short spikes ~5–10x steady).
- Models: fine-tuned chat model for responses; embeddings model for search.
- Security: FintechCo requires private deployment with VPC/KMS integration (flagged for Private/Dedicated).

What we need for the Dedicated capacity sizing call:
- Throughput targets: peak RPS and expected concurrency (examples: 50 RPS peak, 200 concurrent small requests, etc.)
- Typical sequence lengths: avg prompt tokens and expected response tokens (we use token estimates to size GPU memory/KV cache).
- Latency SLOs: 95th/99th p95 targets (e.g., <200ms p95 for short replies) and whether streaming is required.
- Traffic shape: burstiness and expected growth timeline.

Could you share those numbers (even approximate) and a couple of windows that work for a 30–45 minute capacity sizing call next week? Camila (cc'd) will be our SE on the call to run through throughput math and recommended configs.

I've attached our sizing template to make it easier to fill in the above items: redwood-dedicated-sizing-template.xlsx

Proposed slots (PST):
- Fri Feb 12: 11:00–11:30 or 15:00–15:30
- Mon Feb 15: 09:00–09:30 or 14:00–14:30

If none of those work, send a few times and we'll sync. Looking forward to the next step.

Thanks,
Marissa Cole
Enterprise Account Executive | Redwood Inference
marissa.cole@redwood.com | +1 (415) 555-0182
redwood.com

Marissa — thanks for the summary and the template, that helps. A few quick answers below (happy to share more detail on the call):

- Peak RPS: ~60 RPS during peak minutes today, expecting up to ~300 RPS during promotional spikes.
- Concurrency: realistically ~30 concurrent long-running requests; short requests can spike to ~150 concurrent.
- Typical token counts: avg prompt ~120 tokens, avg response ~480 tokens (so ~600 tokens total per request). We have some longer report generations (~3k tokens) but those are <1% of traffic.
- Latency SLO: aiming for p95 < 250ms for standard replies; streaming for longer responses would be nice but not required day one.
- Growth timeline: planning a gradual ramp over 12 weeks as we onboard new regions.

We can do Fri Feb 12 at 11:00 PST for a 30-minute sizing call — Camila ok to include? Alex will join for the infra side.
